The first release of Elfin Twins GM-021 for the Game Boy Advance!

This runs the toy's original 1996 program on the GBA, so the twins behave exactly as they do on the real toy. No building needed: download the ROM below and put it on your flashcart.

### What to download
- **`elfin-twins.gba`**: the game.
- **`elfin-linktest.gba`**: a small tester for the link cable and the cartridge clock. Handy if you want to play with a friend over a link cable, or if time doesn't seem to pass while the GBA is off.
- **The manual** and **the technical reference** (PDF), if you'd like to know how to raise the twins, or how the toy works inside.

### Before you play
In your flashcart's menu, turn on the **real-time clock** and **SRAM saving** for `elfin-twins.gba`. With the clock on, the twins keep living while the GBA is switched off, and the game catches up when you turn it back on. So remember to feed them before you go!

The game also runs in emulators such as mGBA.

### Good to know
- The buttons: A is ENTER, B is ESC, SELECT/L/R is CLOCK, and START opens the settings.
- Link play works between two emulated toys, but hasn't been tried on two real GBAs yet. If you try it, please open an issue and tell us how it went.

Thank you to azya52, whose [BrickEmuPy](https://github.com/azya52/BrickEmuPy) made all of this possible, and to t.me/oksiniah for providing the toy.
